description: Retrieve a specific provision (člen) from a Slovenian statute. Examples: document_id="zakon-o-kazenskem-postopku", article="148" for 148. člen ZKP. Can also use provision_ref directly. Omit article to get all provisions in the statute.

article.description: Article number (e.g. "148"). Slovenian articles use člen notation.

as_of_date.description: ISO date to retrieve historical version (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: get_provision
